executiveSummary: The Authority remains operationally ready, with all readiness categories Green and no identified threats to overall system integrity. Q3 inspections are complete, Q4 inspections are underway, all PCCP stations and complex structures remain mission ready, and routine maintenance continues without operational impacts. The FY26 financial audit was completed with no findings, and October safety performance included no recordable accidents or serious injuries.
maintenanceActivities: Routine levee, floodwall, floodgate, valve, facility, and equipment maintenance continues with no impacts to system readiness.
Hurricane floodgate maintenance is complete; river floodgate maintenance and Q4 valve exercises are progressing.
Field safety checks, required training, facility preparation, and seasonal readiness activities continue during hurricane season.
Facility repairs, warehouse system maintenance, and support infrastructure improvements remain ongoing.
Turf maintenance is slightly behind due to recent rain but catching up as weather conditions improve; no readiness impacts reported.
